name: OpenMausBot
description: Runs a team of Claude, Codex or Grok CLI bots in a local-first chat app, each with its own model, computer and connected apps, for people who want an open Grok Bot alternative.

skills.name: Create Bot
skills.description: Creates and configures bots, channels and task conversations, including bot profiles and the model each bot runs.

skills.name: Send Work
skills.description: Sends work to a bot or channel and waits for the conversation to settle, need input, fail, stall or time out.

skills.name: Search Transcripts
skills.description: Searches local transcripts and reads bounded message pages for bots and channels without returning screenshot pixels.

skills.name: Switch Model
skills.description: Lists configured model instances and switches an idle bot to an exact available Claude, Codex or Grok model.

skills.name: Headless Run
skills.description: Applies a team from a YAML file and runs a bot job from scripts or CI with openmausbot run, exporting what it made.
